steps.description: We plan every hub alongside parents, teachers, and village elders.

steps.title: Equip & Mobilize

faqSection.title: Common questions
faqSection.description: Quick answers about how our programs operate.

faqs.question: How much of my donation goes to fieldwork?
faqs.answer: 94% goes directly into books, meals, medical supplies, and local educator stipends.

faqs.question: How do you select partner villages?
faqs.answer: We partner with rural clusters lacking nearby schools or clinics where village councils invite collaboration.

faqs.question: How can I join the volunteer team?
faqs.answer: Visit our Volunteer page to explore our team tracks and connect with our coordinators.

faqs.question: How are campaign results shared?
faqs.answer: We publish quarterly dispatches with field photos, attendance milestones, and expense summaries.
